definition: a person who receives property after a death
description: In an old wood-panelled lawyer's office on a rainy day, a young woman with messy red hair held up by pencils, in a paint-splashed denim jacket, sits at a leather-topped desk with her hands at her open mouth in shock. An old man slides a big ring of old iron keys and a worn leather folder towards her. She grabs the keys, lifts them up and stares at them with a huge excited smile. Behind her, relatives in black suits and dresses stare in disbelief, one man getting up, beside a grandfather clock and shelves of law books.
